findings.label: blocking
findings.text: Rule 1 banned employee rights for 'desempregada': a mother fired while pregnant would be classified desempregada and lose the stability she still has against the ex-employer.
findings.response: Fixed: classify by the job she had when pregnant or dismissed; fired-while-pregnant is clt/domestica and keeps those rights. Checked live with Claude.

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: Every 'diarista' and every 'sem carteira' treated as non-employee; 'if unsure, don't cite' defaults to silence.
findings.response: Fixed: >2 days in one house = domestica even without carteira or if she says diarista; doubt means 'pode valer, confirme no sindicato'. Checked live.
